tDiscrepTimerX1(IN := (rDeltaX_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaX_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerX2(IN := (rDeltaX_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaX_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerX3(IN := (rDeltaX_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaX_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);

IF tDiscrepTimerX1.Q THEN bAccX1_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerX2.Q THEN bAccX2_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerX3.Q THEN bAccX3_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;

IF bResetFaults THEN
    bAccX1_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccX2_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccX3_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

iHealthySensorsX := 0;
IF bAccX1_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsX := iHealthySensorsX + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccX2_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsX := iHealthySensorsX + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccX3_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsX := iHealthySensorsX + 1; END_IF;

(* Median voting resolution for X axis *)
IF iHealthySensorsX = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rBldgAccX_Ch1 >= rBldgAccX_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch1 <= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) OR
       ((rBldgAccX_Ch1 <= rBldgAccX_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch1 >= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch1;
    ELSIF ((rBldgAccX_Ch2 >= rBldgAccX_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch2 <= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) OR
          ((rBldgAccX_Ch2 <= rBldgAccX_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch2 >= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch2;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsX = 2 THEN
    (* 2oo2 Average Degraded Mode *)
    IF bAccX1_Valid AND bAccX2_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := (rBldgAccX_Ch1 + rBldgAccX_Ch2) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAccX2_Valid AND bAccX3_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := (rBldgAccX_Ch2 + rBldgAccX_Ch3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := (rBldgAccX_Ch3 + rBldgAccX_Ch1) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsX = 1 THEN
    (* 1oo1 Highly Degraded Fallback Mode *)
    IF bAccX1_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch1;
    ELSIF bAccX2_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch2;
    ELSE rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Redundancy Loss: Freeze Acceleration *)
    rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --- Y-AXIS ACCELEROMETER 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
rDeltaY_12 := ABS(rBldgAccY_Ch1 - rBldgAccY_Ch2);
rDeltaY_23 := ABS(rBldgAccY_Ch2 - rBldgAccY_Ch3);
rDeltaY_31 := ABS(rBldgAccY_Ch3 - rBldgAccY_Ch1);

tDiscrepTimerY1(IN := (rDeltaY_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaY_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerY2(IN := (rDeltaY_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaY_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerY3(IN := (rDeltaY_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaY_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);

IF tDiscrepTimerY1.Q THEN bAccY1_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerY2.Q THEN bAccY2_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerY3.Q THEN bAccY3_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;

IF bResetFaults THEN
    bAccY1_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccY2_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccY3_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

iHealthySensorsY := 0;
IF bAccY1_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsY := iHealthySensorsY + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccY2_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsY := iHealthySensorsY + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccY3_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsY := iHealthySensorsY + 1; END_IF;

(* Median voting resolution for Y axis *)
IF iHealthySensorsY = 3 THEN
    IF ((rBldgAccY_Ch1 >= rBldgAccY_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch1 <= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) OR
       ((rBldgAccY_Ch1 <= rBldgAccY_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch1 >= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch1;
    ELSIF ((rBldgAccY_Ch2 >= rBldgAccY_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch2 <= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) OR
          ((rBldgAccY_Ch2 <= rBldgAccY_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch2 >= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch2;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsY = 2 THEN
    IF bAccY1_Valid AND bAccY2_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := (rBldgAccY_Ch1 + rBldgAccY_Ch2) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAccY2_Valid AND bAccY3_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := (rBldgAccY_Ch2 + rBldgAccY_Ch3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := (rBldgAccY_Ch3 + rBldgAccY_Ch1) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsY = 1 THEN
    IF bAccY1_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch1;
    ELSIF bAccY2_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch2;
    ELSE rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 3: WASHOUT HIGH-PASS FILTERING & SENSOR DRIFT REJECTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* High-pass filter removes slow tilt drift, thermal bias, and gravity component from horizontal accelerations *)
(* Transfer function: H(s) = s / (s + 1/tau) -> Discretized: y[k] = (tau/(tau+dt)) * (y[k-1] + x[k] - x[k-1]) *)
rFilteredAccX := (rWashoutTau_s / (rWashoutTau_s + rDt_s)) * (rFilteredAccX + rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 - rWashoutStateX);
rWashoutStateX := rVotedBldgAccX_ms2;

rFilteredAccY := (rWashoutTau_s / (rWashoutTau_s + rDt_s)) * (rFilteredAccY + rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 - rWashoutStateY);
rWashoutStateY := rVotedBldgAccY_ms2;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 4: DYNAMIC STATE OBSERVER & REAL-TIME KALMAN ESTIMATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Discrete prediction and innovation update for X-axis state vector *)
(* Innovations: e_stroke = Measured_Stroke - Estimated_Stroke; e_acc = Measured_Acc - Model_Acc *)
VAR_TEMP
    rInnovStrokeX_m : REAL;
    rInnovAccX_ms2  : REAL;
    rPredAccX_ms2   : REAL;
    rInnovStrokeY_m : REAL;
    rInnovAccY_ms2  : REAL;
    rPredAccY_ms2   : REAL;
END_VAR;

(* X-Axis Observer Evolution *)
rInnovStrokeX_m := rStrokeX_m - rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m;
rPredAccX_ms2   := -(rBuildingOmega0 * rBuildingOmega0 * rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m) -
                   (2.0 * 0.010 * rBuildingOmega0 * rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms) -
                   (rMeasuredHydForceX_kN * 1000.0 / rBuildingModalMass_kg);
rInnovAccX_ms2  := rFilteredAccX - rPredAccX_ms2;

(* State vector integration with observer innovation corrections *)
rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m   := rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m + (rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs11 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s);
rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms   := rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms + (rPredAccX_ms2 * rDt_s) + (rL_obs21 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s) + (rL_obs22 * rInnovAccX_ms2 * rDt_s);
rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m     := rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m + (rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs31 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s);
rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms := rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms + ((- (rDamperOmega0 * rDamperOmega0 * rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m) +
                         ((rMeasuredHydForceX_kN * 1000.0) / rDamperMass_kg) - rPredAccX_ms2) * rDt_s) +
                         (rL_obs41 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s);

(* Y-Axis Observer Evolution *)
rInnovStrokeY_m := rStrokeY_m - rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m;
rPredAccY_ms2   := -(rBuildingOmega0 * rBuildingOmega0 * rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m) -
                   (2.0 * 0.010 * rBuildingOmega0 * rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms) -
                   (rMeasuredHydForceY_kN * 1000.0 / rBuildingModalMass_kg);
rInnovAccY_ms2  := rFilteredAccY - rPredAccY_ms2;

rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m   := rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m + (rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs11 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s);
rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms   := rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms + (rPredAccY_ms2 * rDt_s) + (rL_obs21 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s) + (rL_obs22 * rInnovAccY_ms2 * rDt_s);
rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m     := rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m + (rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs31 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s);
rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms := rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms + ((- (rDamperOmega0 * rDamperOmega0 * rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m) +
                         ((rMeasuredHydForceY_kN * 1000.0) / rDamperMass_kg) - rPredAccY_ms2) * rDt_s) +
                         (rL_obs41 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s);

(* Populate Diagnostic Output Reconstructions *)
rEstimatedBldgDispX_mm := rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m * 1000.0;
rEstimatedBldgDispY_mm := rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m * 1000.0;
rEstimatedBldgVelX_mms := rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms * 1000.0;
rEstimatedBldgVelY_mms := rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms * 1000.0;

(* Track Peak Accelerations and Displacements for Diagnostic Profiling *)
IF ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2) > rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 THEN rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 := ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2); END_IF;
IF ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2) > rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 THEN rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 := ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2); END_IF;
IF ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > rPeakStrokeObserved_mm THEN rPeakStrokeObserved_mm := ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm); END_IF;
IF ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > rPeakStrokeObserved_mm THEN rPeakStrokeObserved_mm := ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm); END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) & STROKE CENTERING FORCE SYNTHESIS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Component 1: Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) Optimal Sway Mitigation Force *)
(* Primary goal: Generate skyhook damping opposing structural roof sway velocity *)
rLqrForceX_kN := - ((rK_lqr_BldgDisp * rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_BldgVel  * rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms) +
                    (rK_lqr_Stroke   * rStrokeX_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_StrokeVel* rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms));

rLqrForceY_kN := - ((rK_lqr_BldgDisp * rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_BldgVel  * rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms) +
                    (rK_lqr_Stroke   * rStrokeY_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_StrokeVel* rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms));

(* Component 2: Nonlinear Progressive Stroke Centering Restoration *)
(* Restores damper mass toward physical geometric null, countering steady wind aerodynamic drag offsets *)
rCenterForceX_kN := - ((rK_center_Linear * rStrokeX_m) +
                       (rK_center_Cubic * rStrokeX_m * rStrokeX_m * rStrokeX_m));

rCenterForceY_kN := - ((rK_center_Linear * rStrokeY_m) +
                       (rK_center_Cubic * rStrokeY_m * rStrokeY_m * rStrokeY_m));

(* Component 3: Virtual Barrier Deceleration Potential Field (MPC Soft Boundary Penalty) *)
(* Injects progressive hydraulic pushback if stroke exceeds safe operating threshold (rStrokeSoftLimit_m = 1.10 m) *)
IF ABS(rStrokeX_m) > rStrokeSoftLimit_m THEN
    IF rStrokeX_m > 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierForceX_kN := - (rK_barrier_Stiff * (rStrokeX_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (rStrokeX_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MAX(0.0, rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms));
    ELSE
        rBarrierForceX_kN := + (rK_barrier_Stiff * (ABS(rStrokeX_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (ABS(rStrokeX_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MIN(0.0, rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms));
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBarrierForceX_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rStrokeY_m) > rStrokeSoftLimit_m THEN
    IF rStrokeY_m > 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierForceY_kN := - (rK_barrier_Stiff * (rStrokeY_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (rStrokeY_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MAX(0.0, rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms));
    ELSE
        rBarrierForceY_kN := + (rK_barrier_Stiff * (ABS(rStrokeY_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (ABS(rStrokeY_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MIN(0.0, rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms));
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBarrierForceY_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Synthesize Net Demand Force and clamp to maximum cylinder hydraulic authority (+/- 400 kN) *)
rTotalDemandedForceX_kN := rLqrForceX_kN + rCenterForceX_kN + rBarrierForceX_kN;
rTotalDemandedForceY_kN := rLqrForceY_kN + rCenterForceY_kN + rBarrierForceY_kN;

IF rTotalDemandedForceX_kN > rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceX_kN := rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;
IF rTotalDemandedForceX_kN < -rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceX_kN := -rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;
IF rTotalDemandedForceY_kN > rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceY_kN := rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;
IF rTotalDemandedForceY_kN < -rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceY_kN := -rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;

rCalculatedForceX_kN := rTotalDemandedForceX_kN;
rCalculatedForceY_kN := rTotalDemandedForceY_kN;

(* Estimate equivalent modal damping ratio achieved: base structural 1.0% + active augmentation *)
rDampingRatioAchieved_Pct := 1.0 + (ABS(rCalculatedForceX_kN) + ABS(rCalculatedForceY_kN)) / 80.0;
IF rDampingRatioAchieved_Pct > 14.5 THEN rDampingRatioAchieved_Pct := 14.5; END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 6: ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC SERVO DRIVER, VALVE LINEARIZATION & MICRO-DITHER
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 100 Hz Micro-Dither Generator (Cycle period 10 ms = 2 cycles of 5 ms PLC task) *)
iDitherCycleCounter := (iDitherCycleCounter + 1) MOD 4;
CASE iDitherCycleCounter OF
    0: rDitherSignal_mA := 0.0;
    1: rDitherSignal_mA := rDitherAmplitude_mA;
    2: rDitherSignal_mA := 0.0;
    3: rDitherSignal_mA := -rDitherAmplitude_mA;
END_CASE;

(* Calculate instantaneous available pressure drop across servo valve spools *)
rAvailDeltaPressX_bar := rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar - ABS(rDeltaPressX_bar) - rHydraulicReturnPres_bar;
IF rAvailDeltaPressX_bar < 25.0 THEN rAvailDeltaPressX_bar := 25.0; END_IF;
rValveFlowScalingX := SQRT(rValveRatedPressureDrop_bar / rAvailDeltaPressX_bar);

rAvailDeltaPressY_bar := rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar - ABS(rDeltaPressY_bar) - rHydraulicReturnPres_bar;
IF rAvailDeltaPressY_bar < 25.0 THEN rAvailDeltaPressY_bar := 25.0; END_IF;
rValveFlowScalingY := SQRT(rValveRatedPressureDrop_bar / rAvailDeltaPressY_bar);

(* Closed-Loop Force PI Controller for X-Axis *)
rForceErrX_kN := rCalculatedForceX_kN - rMeasuredHydForceX_kN;
rForceIntX_kN := rForceIntX_kN + (rForceKi * rForceErrX_kN * rDt_s);
IF rForceIntX_kN > rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntX_kN := rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;
IF rForceIntX_kN < -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntX_kN := -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;

rRawServoCmdX_mA := ((rForceKp * rForceErrX_kN) + rForceIntX_kN) * rValveFlowScalingX + rDitherSignal_mA;
IF rRawServoCmdX_mA > rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdX_mA := rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rRawServoCmdX_mA < -rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdX_mA := -rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop Force PI Controller for Y-Axis *)
rForceErrY_kN := rCalculatedForceY_kN - rMeasuredHydForceY_kN;
rForceIntY_kN := rForceIntY_kN + (rForceKi * rForceErrY_kN * rDt_s);
IF rForceIntY_kN > rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntY_kN := rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;
IF rForceIntY_kN < -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntY_kN := -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;

rRawServoCmdY_mA := ((rForceKp * rForceErrY_kN) + rForceIntY_kN) * rValveFlowScalingY + rDitherSignal_mA;
IF rRawServoCmdY_mA > rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdY_mA := rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rRawServoCmdY_mA < -rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdY_mA := -rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State timer execution *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#24H);
iPrevState := iState;

(* Hardwired E-Stop and Catastrophic Limit Interlock Check *)
IF NOT bSafetyEStopOk THEN
    iState := 99; (* Transition directly to emergency latched trip *)
ELSIF (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) OR (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) THEN
    iState := 99; (* Mechanical overstroke limit switch hit *)
ELSIF rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 140.0 AND (iState >= 30) THEN
    iState := 90; (* Hydraulic pressure rail collapse: initiate controlled brake clamping *)
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_SYSTEM_BOOT_INIT *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE; (* Keep parking brakes fully engaged *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;
        rForceIntX_kN           := 0.0;
        rForceIntY_kN           := 0.0;

        IF bSafetyEStopOk AND bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_HYDRAULIC_WARMUP_AND_PRESSURIZATION *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE;
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;

        tHpuWarmupTimer(IN := (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar >= 240.0) AND (rHydraulicOilTemp_DegC >= 25.0), PT := T#3S);
        IF tHpuWarmupTimer.Q THEN
            tHpuWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SENSOR_CALIBRATION_AND_LVDT_ZEROING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE;
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;

        (* Check sensor sanity and stable zeroing *)
        tCalibDwellTimer(IN := (iHealthySensorsX >= 2) AND (iHealthySensorsY >= 2), PT := T#2S);
        IF tCalibDwellTimer.Q THEN
            tCalibDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 25;
        END_IF;

    25: (* STATE_HYDRAULIC_BRAKE_RELEASE_SEQUENCE *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE; (* Command caliper brake release solenoids *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;

        tBrakeReleaseDwell(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tBrakeReleaseDwell.Q THEN
            tBrakeReleaseDwell(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_DORMANT_STANDBY (CALM WEATHER / LOW STRUCTURAL EXCITATION) *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := (iHealthySensorsX < 3) OR (iHealthySensorsY < 3) OR (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 250.0);
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Apply gentle centering current to hold mass precisely at origin *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := - (0.012 * rMassStrokeX_mm) + rDitherSignal_mA;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := - (0.012 * rMassStrokeY_mm) + rDitherSignal_mA;

        (* Seismic early warning priority bypass *)
        IF bSeismicPWaveTrigger THEN
            iState := 60;
        (* Wake-up threshold: Wind velocity > 12 m/s OR Top acceleration > 0.040 m/s2 *)
        ELSIF bAutoModeSelect AND ((rAnemometerSpeed_ms > 12.0) OR (ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2) > 0.040) OR (ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2) > 0.040)) THEN
            IF bDegradedModeActive THEN
                iState := 50;
            ELSE
                iState := 40;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_ACTIVE_SWAY_CONTROL (FULL CLOSED-LOOP LQR + MPC CENTERING) *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := rRawServoCmdX_mA;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := rRawServoCmdY_mA;

        (* Degradation transition *)
        IF (iHealthySensorsX < 3) OR (iHealthySensorsY < 3) OR (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 250.0) THEN
            iState := 50;
        (* Seismic override *)
        ELSIF bSeismicPWaveTrigger THEN
            iState := 60;
        (* Quiet weather decay transition to Standby *)
        ELSIF (rAnemometerSpeed_ms < 8.0) AND (ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2) < 0.020) AND (ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2) < 0.020) AND (tStateTimer.ET > T#10M) THEN
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_DEGRADED_ACTIVE_CONTROL (REDUCED ENVELOPE / REDUNDANCY LOSS) *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Limit servo current to 70% rated capacity to protect stressed hydraulic plant *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := rRawServoCmdX_mA * 0.70;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := rRawServoCmdY_mA * 0.70;

        (* If all sensors on an axis fail, or supply pressure severely degrades, abort to centering deceleration *)
        IF (iHealthySensorsX = 0) OR (iHealthySensorsY = 0) OR (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 180.0) THEN
            iState := 80;
        (* Recovery to full mode if issues cleared *)
        ELSIF (iHealthySensorsX = 3) AND (iHealthySensorsY = 3) AND (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar >= 260.0) THEN
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_SEISMIC_EMERGENCY_DISSIPATION *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Maximum energy dissipation mode: Command maximum skyhook damping and stroke resistance *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := rRawServoCmdX_mA;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := rRawServoCmdY_mA;

        tSeismicOverdriveTimer(IN := bSeismicPWaveTrigger, PT := T#120S);
        IF NOT bSeismicPWaveTrigger AND tSeismicOverdriveTimer.Q THEN
            tSeismicOverdriveTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_DECELERATION_AND_HYDRAULIC_SNUBBING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Ramp stroke toward zero with heavy velocity damping *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := - (0.025 * rMassStrokeX_mm) - (0.015 * rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms * 1000.0);
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := - (0.025 * rMassStrokeY_mm) - (0.015 * rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms * 1000.0);

        IF (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) < 15.0) AND (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) < 15.0) AND (tStateTimer.ET > T#4S) THEN
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_HYDRAULIC_BRAKE_CLAMP_PARKING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE; (* De-energize brake solenoid -> Spring clamps engage *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;
        rForceIntX_kN           := 0.0;
        rForceIntY_kN           := 0.0;

        IF bResetFaults AND bMasterEnable AND (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar >= 240.0) THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_SAFETY_ESTOP_LATCHED *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE; (* Calipers clamped immediately *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;
        rForceIntX_kN           := 0.0;
        rForceIntY_kN           := 0.0;

        IF bResetFaults AND bSafetyEStopOk AND (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) < (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) AND (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) < (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 8: ISA-18.2 ALARM PACKING & SYSTEM STATUS DIAGNOSTICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Reset alarm words *)
wAlarmWord1 := 16#0000;
wAlarmWord2 := 16#0000;
wSystemStatusWord := 16#0000;

(* --- Priority 1 & 2 Alarms (wAlarmWord1) --- *)
IF NOT bSafetyEStopOk THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0001; END_IF;                  (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
IF ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0) THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0002; END_IF; (* Bit 1: X-Axis Overstroke Hard Limit *)
IF ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0) THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0004; END_IF; (* Bit 2: Y-Axis Overstroke Hard Limit *)
IF rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 140.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0008; END_IF;  (* Bit 3: Hydraulic Pressure Collapse Trip *)
IF rHydraulicOilTemp_DegC > 75.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0010; END_IF;     (* Bit 4: Hydraulic Oil Critical High Temp *)
IF (iHealthySensorsX = 0) OR (iHealthySensorsY = 0) THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0020; END_IF; (* Bit 5: Complete Sensor TMR Redundancy Loss *)
IF ABS(rForceErrX_kN) > 90.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0040; END_IF;          (* Bit 6: X-Axis Cylinder Force Tracking Deviation *)
IF ABS(rForceErrY_kN) > 90.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0080; END_IF;          (* Bit 7: Y-Axis Cylinder Force Tracking Deviation *)

(* --- Priority 3 Alarms & Warnings (wAlarmWord2) --- *)
IF (iHealthySensorsX = 2) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0001; END_IF;            (* Bit 0: X-Axis Sensor Degraded to 2oo2 *)
IF (iHealthySensorsX = 1) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0002; END_IF;            (* Bit 1: X-Axis Sensor Degraded to 1oo1 *)
IF (iHealthySensorsY = 2) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0004; END_IF;            (* Bit 2: Y-Axis Sensor Degraded to 2oo2 *)
IF (iHealthySensorsY = 1) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0008; END_IF;            (* Bit 3: Y-Axis Sensor Degraded to 1oo1 *)
IF (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > 950.0) OR (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > 950.0) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0010; END_IF; (* Bit 4: High Stroke Soft Pre-Warning *)
IF rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 220.0 THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0020; END_IF;  (* Bit 5: Hydraulic Rail Low Pressure Warning *)
IF rHydraulicOilTemp_DegC > 65.0 THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0040; END_IF;     (* Bit 6: Hydraulic Oil High Temp Warning *)
IF bSeismicPWaveTrigger THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0080; END_IF;              (* Bit 7: Active Seismic Event Detected *)
IF rAnemometerSpeed_ms > 35.0 THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0100; END_IF;        (* Bit 8: Hurricane Force Wind Velocity Warning *)

(* --- System Status Diagnostic Word (wSystemStatusWord) --- *)
wSystemStatusWord := INT_TO_WORD(iState) AND 16#00FF;                                    (* Bits 0-7: Active State Machine Index *)
IF bSystemReady THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0100; END_IF;           (* Bit 8: System Ready Flag *)
IF bActiveDampingEngaged THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0200; END_IF;  (* Bit 9: Closed-Loop Active Damping Engaged *)
IF bDegradedModeActive THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0400; END_IF;    (* Bit 10: Degraded Mode Running *)
IF bHydraulicBrakeRelease THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0800; END_IF; (* Bit 11: Hydraulic Calipers Released *)

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
